name: Karen
tagline: Phones a company and works your case until it is closed out
description: A customer-advocacy caller built on phone automation. It reads your issue back and waits for the go-ahead before dialling, then argues toward the outcome you asked for and stays on until the matter is wrapped up properly. Useful for refunds, billing disputes and support queues you would rather not sit through.
author: KevinLH811
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
